insert.column: SELECT ml.id AS "Loan ID", ml.client_id AS "ID del Cliente", TO_CHAR(mlc.expire_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS "Policy Expire Date", mlc.is_endorse AS "Endorse status", mc.insurance_company AS "Insurance Company", mc.insurance_name AS "Insurer Name" FROM m_loan ml INNER JOIN m_loan_charge mlc ON ml.id = mlc.loan_id INNER JOIN m_charge mc ON mlc.charge_id = mc.id WHERE (mc.insurance_company = '${insuranceCompany}' OR '${insuranceCompany}' = '-1') AND mlc.expire_date BETWEEN '${startDate}' AND '${endDate}'
